name: asterloom
description: A local-first studio for turning your materials into portable learning adventures.

scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-retrieval-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ocr-assets.mjs && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test:server: node --test server/server.test.mjs server/provider-connections.test.mjs server/web-extraction.test.mjs server/media.test.mjs server/media.integration.test.mjs server/media-runtime.test.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: esbuild src/lib/package.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=desktop/generated/package-validation.mjs && node --test desktop/bundles.test.mjs desktop/media-archive.test.mjs desktop/verified-download.test.mjs desktop/tor-verification-keys.test.mjs desktop/media-build-config.test.mjs desktop/copy-native-tree.test.mjs desktop/native-dependencies.test.mjs

author: Nimesh Pandeya (NimeshBuilds)
